mainEntity.name: Are there different stucco finishes, and how do they impact appearance and cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are several stucco finishes, each offering a distinct appearance and varying impact on cost. Common finishes include smooth, sand (fine, medium, coarse), dash, worm, and Santa Barbara. A smooth finish provides a sleek, modern look but requires meticulous application, which can increase labor costs. Sand finishes, with their aggregate texture, are popular and more forgiving. Dash finishes involve throwing wet stucco onto the wall, creating a spiky texture. The choice of finish affects the amount of material used, labor intensity, and overall aesthetic, influencing the final cost of your stucco project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco offers various finishes like smooth, sand, dash, and Santa Barbara, which affect appearance, material usage, and labor intensity, thus influencing overall project cost.
